owner_rules: Done means ALL evidence: implemented as specified (task id), a test that FAILED before and passes now, suites green, committed AND pushed to main of the repo named in the task description.
Never defer: no 'later', 'follow-up', 'out of scope'. If blocked: what blocks, what you tried, what you need; then continue with the next independent task.
Honest reporting: TASK-ID | status | commit | tests | measured vs target | missing.
Nothing is called replicated-and-verified, signed-and-true, or converged-and-completed: these are different states (MV-ARCH-08).
Free-core recall is never deliberately weakened and the licensed CRDT engine is never imported into the Apache-2.0 core (MV-REC-06).

Each task names its repo in the description; scope paths are relative to that repo. The programme contract is intended to live in memev-ops (precedent: the sibling programme); proofline runs in one root, so a verifier is run from the clone of the named repo.
One claim register (contracts/CLAIMS.md): a work package is written by one author at a time.
